AIRK TRAINING MODIFICATIONS AND DATA ATTRIBUTION
These encoder weights were changed by local contrastive question-to-evidence training. Base: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 at10dbd2f06a8baf40ad285b037edda610c1b9a57c, Apache-2.0. The tokenizer is unchanged. Actual training/source hashes and recipe are retained in the release qualification receipt.
